recipes.title: Create a bounded primitive assembly

guidance.reason: One accepted leaf creates multiple planned primitives atomically, so no single Blender menu item can represent the action honestly. Split meaningful parts into separate leaves for native teaching guidance.

recipes.title: Subdivide an owned mesh through a bounded Edit Mode operation

guidance.reason: The accepted action subdivides every edge into a new owned mesh datablock and swaps the target link transactionally; Blender's context-sensitive operator alone cannot express that ownership and rollback contract.

recipes.title: Triangulate an owned mesh through a bounded Edit Mode operation

guidance.reason: The accepted action triangulates the complete bounded mesh into a new owned datablock with fixed FIXED/EAR_CLIP methods and swaps the target link transactionally; Blender's context-sensitive operator alone cannot express that ownership and rollback contract.

recipes.title: Extrude an explicit owned mesh face region through a bounded Edit Mode operation

guidance.reason: The accepted action resolves stable source polygon indices, validates one connected bounded region, extrudes it by an exact local-space vector into a new owned mesh datablock, and swaps the target link transactionally; Blender's context-sensitive operator alone cannot express that ownership, selection, observation, and rollback contract.

recipes.title: Add a bounded Bevel modifier

guidance.reason: The action must bind exact width, segment, angle, ownership, and compensation state; the public UI API does not expose a stable rectangle or single operator for the whole transaction.

recipes.title: Add a bounded Solidify modifier

guidance.reason: The action must bind exact thickness, offset, ownership, bounded topology, and compensation state while fixing mode to EXTRUDE, even offset and rim on, and rim-only off; the public UI API does not expose a stable rectangle or single operator for the whole transaction.

recipes.title: Create an inspectable Transform Geometry node group

guidance.reason: The accepted action creates the node group interface, graph, values, modifier binding, and rollback receipt atomically; no single native control represents the complete graph.

recipes.title: Create and assign one Principled material

guidance.reason: The canonical action creates and assigns the exact material through Blender data APIs; stable native rectangles for the Properties controls are not exposed by the supported public UI API.

recipes.title: Create and assign a Principled material palette

guidance.reason: One accepted leaf creates several materials and assignments atomically; Blender does not expose one native control that represents the whole palette operation.

recipes.title: Create and bind a rigid armature

guidance.reason: The accepted action creates several bones and rigid object bindings as one compensated transaction, not as one allowlisted native menu command.

recipes.title: Bind explicit skin weights

guidance.reason: The accepted action validates and assigns a complete bounded per-vertex weight table plus an Armature modifier atomically; Blender has no single native control representing that transaction.

recipes.title: Create pose transform keyframes

guidance.reason: The accepted action writes a bounded set of exact frames, pose transforms, interpolation, and extrapolation atomically; the native keyframe command alone cannot represent that complete parameterized transaction.

recipes.title: Create an isolated render scene and world

guidance.reason: The action creates an owned scene, world, and collection linkage together; Blender has no single allowlisted native control for the complete operation.

recipes.title: Create Area lights and a camera

guidance.reason: One accepted leaf creates and configures multiple lights plus a camera; no single native menu item represents the complete action or rollback receipt.

recipes.title: Render a managed PNG preview

guidance.reason: The accepted action also applies bounded render settings and writes to an adapter-managed PNG destination, so the ordinary Render Image item is only a semantic reference.
